title: Execute audited Checkbox component polish
description: Implement Checkbox audit findings after modularization, including custom indicator, layout, states, counts, and accessibility.
objective: Make Checkbox deliberate instead of leaving it as browser residue inside a styled pill system.
expected_outputs: Hover, selected, focus, disabled, and count states
acceptance_criteria: Checkbox remains multi-select and keyboard accessible.
Visual indicator is distinct from Radio and Chips.
Long labels and counts remain contained.
verification: PHP lint, JS syntax, CSS check, WP-CLI harness, and line-budget guard pass.

budgets.validation_budget: mechanical checks plus Guilherme visual QA

risks: Hiding native inputs without an accessible replacement can degrade keyboard behavior.
